_meta.source: R1043 question text from frontend/CLAUDE.md §3.6; resolution criteria quote the ACAPS trigger objectives in the Risk Radar export; replay questions are built from resolved risks in the export
_meta.note: similarRisks is filled in by lib/api.ts from similar_risks.json. Replay questions are practice rounds on real resolved risks: their outcomes come from the export's Status field; their deadlines are approximate because the export has no creation dates.

items.text: Will cross-border attacks in eastern Chad become sustained and recurrent, affecting multiple border localities and causing significant civilian casualties, displacement or access disruption, by 6 May 2027?
items.resolutionCriteria: Resolves yes if ACAPS's trigger T0618 reaches 100% by 6 May 2027. ACAPS's objective for 100%: "100% completion would be reached if cross-border attacks become sustained and recurrent, affecting multiple border localities in eastern Chad and causing significant civilian casualties, displacement, or humanitarian access disruptions."

context.triggerUpdate: On 21 August, Chad said Sudanese army aircraft and drones struck a convoy more than 100 km inside Ennedi-Est, and raised its regional alert level to the highest. On 28 August, an air strike near the border killed at least 12 people at a fuel market.

evidence.title: Chad accuses Sudan of cross-border strike, raises alert level
evidence.summary: Chad says Sudanese army aircraft and drones struck a convoy more than 100 km inside Ennedi-Est province. Authorities raised the regional alert level to its highest and deployed more forces.

evidence.title: Chad accuses Sudan of deadly air strike near shared border
evidence.summary: An air strike near the border killed at least 12 people at a fuel market, adding to civilian protection risks and fears of escalation.
